feed.title: NHID-Clinical
feed.subtitle: Release notes and updates from NHID-Clinical — an open policy-and-evidence layer for healthcare administrative AI voice interactions.

entry.title: Corpus Evaluation Path Corrected — IDG-01 and EIT-01
entry.summary: The first run of the 150-session synthetic corpus evaluation reported IDG-01 at a 100% false-positive rate and EIT-01 at 0% detection. Those numbers were real, but they measured defects in the corpus-evaluation path rather than in the policy engine, which was not modified.

entry.title: Why Identity Is the Missing Layer of Responsible AI
entry.summary: Independent commentary on Impersonation Latency and the five NHID-Clinical controls, mapped to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and HIPAA.

entry.title: DBC-01 Coverage Expanded from Real-Corpus Mining
entry.summary: Detection of DBC-01 (Deceptive Behavior Claim) against real conversational phrasing — measured on the Fabricate Battle-Test Corpus (550 real-world voice AI conversations) — was 0.5% prior to this update. Mining the corpus for missed phrasing patterns and additively expanding the heuristic phrase list raised that to 2.5%.

entry.title: Community Channels Consolidated to GitHub
entry.summary: Discord and Reddit are no longer used for NHID-Clinical community discussion. All community activity — questions, implementation experiences, and proposal feedback — now happens in GitHub Discussions on the main repository.

entry.title: NHID-Clinical v1.3 Published
entry.summary: v1.3 is the first public release of this open proposal. It suggests four behavioral expectations for AI voice agents in healthcare payer–provider administrative calls, focused on early disclosure of automated status.

entry.title: Pilot Partners Sought
entry.summary: We are actively seeking payer and provider organizations to run a 90-day shadow evaluation — observe-only, non-intercepting, no vendor changes. Observe incoming AI voice calls against the v1.3 behavioral baseline and help shape the standard before v2 ships.

entry.title: Submitted to NIST
entry.summary: NHID-Clinical was submitted as a public comment to NIST docket NIST-2025-0035 (AI-agent security). Comment ID: NIST-2025-0035-0026. This is a public comment — not a regulatory filing or endorsement. The RFI drew 932 public comments in total before the period closed in March 2026.

entry.title: Community Channels Open
entry.summary: NHID-Clinical community discussion channels are now open. Join to ask questions about this proposal, share implementation experiences, and contribute to future versions. (Update, June 2026: community discussion has since moved to GitHub Discussions — see the June 2026 announcement above.)
